# datadog_integration_openai_codex_account (Resource)

Provides a Datadog OpenAI Codex integration account resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication` (Attributes) Authentication configured on the OpenAI Codex integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the OpenAI Codex integration account.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings configured on the OpenAI Codex integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Optional

- `dataflows` (Attributes) Data Datadog collects from OpenAI Codex, keyed by dataflow ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication`

Optional:

- `open_ai_codex_integration_account_bearer_token_auth` (Attributes) The bearer token authentication method configured on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--open_ai_codex_integration_account_bearer_token_auth))

<a id="nestedatt--authentication--open_ai_codex_integration_account_bearer_token_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.open_ai_codex_integration_account_bearer_token_auth`

Optional:

- `auth_type` (String) The authentication method type. Valid values are `bearer_token`. Defaults to `"bearer_token"`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Workspace-scoped OpenAI Admin key with the `codex.enterprise.analytics.read` scope. To collect turn metrics, also grant `chatgpt.enterprise.compliance_logs_platform.workspace_analytics.read` to the same key. Exactly one of `token` or `token_wo` must be set. Prefer `token_wo`, which Terraform 1.11+ keeps out of state; this attribute is stored in Terraform state.
- `token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Workspace-scoped OpenAI Admin key with the `codex.enterprise.analytics.read` scope. To collect turn metrics, also grant `chatgpt.enterprise.compliance_logs_platform.workspace_analytics.read` to the same key. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state. Requires Terraform 1.11+.
- `token_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for token_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.



<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Required:

- `codex_workspace_id` (String) ID of the Codex workspace to collect data from.


<a id="nestedatt--dataflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows`

Optional:

- `openai_codex_dora` (Attributes) A daily per-engineer engagement signal that [AI Impact](https://docs.datadoghq.com/delivery_performance/ai_impact/) uses to attribute AI-assisted pull requests. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--openai_codex_dora))
- `openai_codex_turn_metrics` (Attributes) Hourly turn-level metrics from the OpenAI Compliance Logs Platform, including turn and session identity, Work Insights classification, token usage, credits, estimated cost, duration, and activity for skills, plugins, and artifacts. Turn cost is a provider estimate and can differ from invoiced charges. Requires the `chatgpt.enterprise.compliance_logs_platform.workspace_analytics.read` scope on the key in `authentication`. Without this scope, the dataflow collects no data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--openai_codex_turn_metrics))

Read-Only:

- `openai_codex_metrics` (Attributes) Daily Codex analytics metrics under the `openai.codex.*` namespace: usage totals, token counts by model, thread and turn counts by client, lines of code attributable to Codex, and code reviews. This dataflow is always on and cannot be turned off, so it appears only in responses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--openai_codex_metrics))

Optional:

Read-Only:
